metas.name: Aasiaat 4 Wheeler
metas.note: The most noticeable feature of the coverage in Aasiaat is the windshield with a shiny red, white and black reflection. The large, round side mirrors can also be used to identify the town. The coverage is very sunny and has thick, thawing snow along most of the roads.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Bright Red Boat
metas.note: This bright red boat can be found on the east coast near the towns of Tiilerillaq and Kuummiit respectively. While the coverage near Tiilerillaq does not have a cloud in sight, the coverage near Kuummiit is somewhat overcast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Grey Nuuk Car
metas.note: While Nuuk is most easily recognized by the grey Street View car, it can also be recognized by being the largest city by far.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Iluslissat 4 Wheeler
metas.note: Most coverage in Ilulissat can be recognized by the green 4 wheeler with black bars and the driver wearing a beige hat. Note however that there are some small sections where the driver does not wear it. The coverage is fairly sunny and bright.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Maniitsoq Tractor
metas.note: The coverage in Maniitsoq was taken by a tractor, making it very recognizable. The coverage is overcast and fairly snowy.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Narsaq Car
metas.note: Narsaq can be identified by the thin antenna seen on the right side of the car. The coverage is very sunny and fairly green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Qaqortoq Red Car
metas.note: Qaqortoq can be recognized by the red rectangular car. The coverage is extremely sunny and the area is greener and less barren than most of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Red Square Cabin Boat
metas.note: The boat with a red square cabin can be found at multiple locations on the west coast. Around Saqaaq, Ilimanaq, Kangerluk, Akunnaaq, and Sisimiut. Most significantly by and around Akunnaaq. The areas covered are similar to the red roof boat.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Sisimiut 4 Wheeler
metas.note:
The city of Sisimiut can be easily recognized by the black 4 wheeler with side mirrors pointing straight up. The coverage is generally very overcast and grey.

  • Changed "snowmobile" to "4 wheeler" from plonkit description as I'm pretty sure that's not a snowmobile
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tasiilaq 4 Wheeler
metas.note: The coverage in Tasiilaq can be recognized by the 4 wheeler with large grey handguards on either side. The coverage has a lot of very thin clouds and the area is somewhat green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Uummannaq 4 Wheeler
metas.note:
Uummannaq has two distinctive features: a sharp mountain to the north and a green 4 wheeler with large black side mirrors. Neither of the two can be seen on all coverage but at least one can be seen on most.

  • Updated "snowmobile" to "4 wheeler" from the plonkit guide as I'm pretty sure that's not a snowmobile
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: White Boat with Black Box
metas.note: A boat with a black box near the front, and a chequered pattern on the bow can be found fairly north on the east coast near Ittoqqortoormiit and to the west of it. While the western part of the coverage is very foggy and somewhat overcast, the eastern parts of the coverage is slightly less foggy and very sunny. A man wearing a black coat can also be seen captaining the boat.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: White Cabin Red Roof Boat
metas.note:
This boat, with a white cabin and a red roof, can be found by a multitude of towns and villages on the west coast, around Saqqaq, Qeqertarsuaq, Akunnaaq, Sarfannguit, and Aasiaat. Most of the coverage is in the general area around the city of Aasiaat.

  • Note that the square red cabin boat covers many similar adjacent areas.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
